title: The onset of star formation 250 million years after the Big Bang
question: Determine the spectroscopic redshift of the lensed z~9 galaxy MACS1149-JD1 via ALMA [OIII] 88um and test whether its IRAC 4.5um excess implies an early (z~15) star formation episode

evidence.quote: HST and Spitzer as well as VLT/HAWK-I photometry data that support our finding are available in the IOPscience repository

what.value: Lensing magnification from Frontier Fields mass models

evidence.quote: using all the mass models released in the framework of the Frontier Fields survey

what.value: Dust mass absorption coefficient kappa0 = 10 cm2/g at 250 um

evidence.loc: Methods, Upper limits on dust continuum
evidence.quote: κ 0 = 10 cm 2 g − 1 at 250 µ m

recipe.goal: Image cubes and search for line
recipe.method: CLEAN with natural weighting; bin six channels to ~42 km/s; search for >3σ signal in five consecutive channels

recipe.goal: Measure line flux, redshift, width, size
recipe.method: Integrated flux with imfit; 1D spectrum from >3σ region fit with Gaussian; imfit deconvolved size
assumptions: Lensing effects equal for major and minor axes

recipe.goal: Dust continuum upper limit, LIR and dust mass
recipe.method: Collapse all four setups, exclude line; 3σ limit; modified blackbody over 8-1000 um with CMB correction
assumptions: Td=30-60 K (fiducial 40 K), beta_d=1.5, kappa0=10 cm2/g at 250um, emitting region one beam, mu=10

recipe.goal: SED fitting for star formation history
recipe.method: Custom SED code with GALAXEV, nebular emission, [OIII] flux and dust upper limit; compare single and two-component SFHs (tau=10-400 Myr)
key_parameters: Fiducial tau=100 Myr; Chabrier IMF 0.1-100 Msun; Calzetti law; escape fraction 0

evidence.quote: The peak intensity of MACS1149-JD1 is 129 . 8 ± 17 . 5 mJy km s − 1 beam − 1

evidence.loc: Methods, Upper limits on dust continuum
evidence.quote: we obtain the 3 σ dust mass upper limit of 5 . 3 × 10 5 × (10 /µ ) M ⊙
corresponding to Ly α at a redshift of 9 . 0942 ± 0 . 0019

not_stated_but_needed: CLEAN threshold, mask, image size and cell size
Which of the SPWs/channels were used for continuum and their weighting
Exact spectral extraction region and Gaussian fit procedure details
Velocity-integrated map channel selection beyond 335.5-335.8 GHz
SED fitting grid details beyond tables, MC procedure
Lens model choice for magnification beyond fiducial mu=10
score_reason: Public data and code, key numbers given, but imaging parameters missing and SED analysis model-dependent.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric line results, simple recipe for line detection.
